items.title: Tokenization could unleash tens of billions of dollars in trapped capital, Nasdaq CEO says
items.summary: Tokenization could free up tens of billions of dollars in capital tied up in assets used as collateral across the global financial system, Nasdaq CEO Adena Friedman said.

items.title: Little relief expected for gas prices ahead of Election Day, according to prediction markets
items.summary: Affordability is seen as one of voters' top issues heading into the 2026 midterm elections .

items.title: After a yearslong slump, China's real estate market may be set for a turnaround
items.summary: BEIJING — An end is in sight for China's yearslong property market slump, S&P Global Ratings analysts said in a report distributed Thursday.

items.title: Huawei doubles down on smartphones as EV sales slow
items.summary: BEIJING — Faced with a slowdown in the smartphone and car markets, Huawei's consumer business is choosing to focus on phones with homegrown chips.

items.title: Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says
items.summary: The cost of many everyday items would have declined last year and early this year without President Donald Trump 's tariffs, according to the New York Federal Reserve .
